title: An efficient self-driven fog harvesting system based on a Kelvin waterdrop generator
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01116C, Paper
Xingsheng Yang, Yunfu Cui, Yingli Li, Hongru Pei, Wanpei Lin, Zhengling Dang, Shenghui Han, Suo Bai, Bo Sun, Li Cheng
We report a new self-powered Kelvin waterdrop generator driven fog harvesting system with increased fog harvesting efficiency especially under low concentration fog conditions.
